lines: // Mild angular/linear damping keeps debris settling stable.
+      // Rolling resistance + extra damping once debris is nearly at rest,
+      // so rubble piles settle instead of creeping indefinitely.
+      if(sp0<0.6){ const d=Math.max(0,1-2.6*dt); b.vx*=d; b.vy*=d; b.w*=Math.max(0,1-3.5*dt); }
+      if(sp0>55){ b.vx*=55/sp0; b.vy*=55/sp0; } // numerical safety cap
